newsitem.title: UK: Euro cotton markets quieten, lack direction.
newsitem.headline: Euro cotton markets quieten, lack direction.

text.p: Many European markets reported quiet trading in the absence of fresh clarification regarding price direction, industry sources said.
Much concern continues to be expressed about weather conditions in several countries and about the possibility that the quality of lint produced this season will be below average.
Some mills buyers have thus recently begun to enquire more diligently for better grade styles, the sources said.
Spanish and selected African descriptions have been mentioned in this context.
Customary demand has also been noted for Central Asian cottons but turnover has been routine.
